fieldNotes.pngSha256: SHA-256 of the final PNG bytes saved in the release directory.
fieldNotes.apkSourceSha256: SHA-256 of the PNG originally extracted from the APK, before any pixel-identical byte reuse; null for supplemental files.
fieldNotes.rgbaSha256: SHA-256 of decoded RGBA bytes; image dimensions are also checked separately.
fieldNotes.reusedFrom: Repository-relative path whose encoded PNG bytes were reused after exact width/height/RGBA equality; null when APK extraction bytes were retained.
fieldNotes.supplemental: Only Icons.png is supplemental: it is an existing UI helper and was not extracted from this APK.
